lines.say: Hey, students with A D H D. Does this sound like you?
Called lazy at every parents' evening. Capable, but lazy. Detentions, isolation.
That was my brother. One of the smartest people I know, obsessed with planes and mechanics.
He was diagnosed at eighteen, after he failed his A-levels.
The problem was never ability. It was planning, starting, and keeping track.
So I built Offload. It holds the plan for you, and when you miss a day, it moves the work into your free time, and tells you what moved.
So you never start from zero.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
